If the default branch already does this, open no PR: say where it is implemented and which test covers it. Otherwise open a draft pull request against its default branch titled "[enact-golden] <short summary>", wait for the repository's own CI and report the PR URL and the check results. Do not merge.

must_include: the repository's own CI checks passing on the PR head
the MOVE verb contract for sftp

prints a secret, API key or token value
